    Reduction of long critical singular paths to BGRS Figures 14 and 15 #

    The two imported files contain the literal finite sources and their explicit one-parameter module families. This file isolates the remaining geometric content of BGRS 4.3: a critical singular path of length at least three must produce either the Figure-14 diagram or the bound Figure-15 diagram in the primitive projectives, and the induced Hom bifunctor must split.

    This is deliberately a diagram-and-complement callback. It assumes neither representation-infiniteness nor the desired exclusion of long critical paths.

    Prop

    A literal Figure-14 diagram in the primitive projectives, together with the Hom-bifunctor splitting which makes its source a cleaving diagram.

        Exact BGRS-4.3 extraction boundary. For each critical singular ray path of length at least three, it returns one of the two displayed cleaving diagrams. The result is concrete finite diagram data plus a linear splitting of the induced Hom bifunctor; it is not an equivalent-strength infinitude assumption.
